notes.title: Our first major post-launch update arrives at June 6!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45449805/19234dfa65bf1e98b006d5b2eb70ca92e8659c47.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Key Improvements:[/p][p]1. Performance Optimazation[/p][p]- Redesigned loading logic to eliminate lag spikes[/p][p]2. Subtitle Sync Fix[/p][p]- Fixed timing mismatches in all dialogue sequences[/p][p]3. Save & Story Progression[/p][p]-  Resolved bugs blocking branch unlocks and save corruption[/p][p]4. 2x Playback Optimization[/p][p]- Smoothed video playback during fast-forward mode[/p][p]5. Achievement System Patch[/p][p]- Rebalanced Steam achievement triggers and fixed unlock failures[/p][p]6. Ending Cinematic Remastered[/p][p]- Reframed every ending cutscene for narrative consistency[/p][p]7. Community Reported Fixes[/p][p]- Addressed player reported issues + QA findings[/p][p]Thank you for all your support！ We remain committed to further updates – this is just the first step in our flight plan.[/p][p]With gratitude,[/p][p]Lost in the Secret Team[/p]

notes.title: 现在我们终于要迎来游戏发售后的首次大更新！将于6月6日上线
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家朋友们，你们好!
大家好！这里是《消失的航班，还有她她她！》制作组。首先要再次为之前游戏版本中的不完善向大家深深鞠躬致歉。感谢大家在此期间给予的宽容和理解，你们每一条真挚的意见和建议都对我们的游戏提供了很大的帮助。

notes.title: Dear Players, here we are!
notes.content:
After tireless efforts by our development team, we’re thrilled to announce that the critical issues have been resolved. 
Lost in the Secret (《消失的航班，还有她她她！》) is now officially confirmed for release on May 21, 2025!

While this "flight" experienced delays, we promise the journey will be worth the wait. Your unwavering support fuels our commitment to delivering an exceptional gaming experience.

With gratitude,
The Lost in the Secret  Team

notes.title: Urgent Apology For Postpone Launch
notes.content:
Dear Players,
We sincerely apologize，during the final optimization of the QTE feature before the product's launch, a severe data loss bug occurred. After attempting emergency fixes without success, in order not to affect your gaming experience, we have decided to postpone the launch.
Our technical team is working hard to fix the issue, and we will inform you of the new launch date as soon as the fix is confirmed.
Thank you for your understanding and support of the our team. We hope you can see our sincerity. Although this flight has been delayed, it is still worth looking forward to. We also promise to reward your wait with a better gaming experience!
Lost in the secret Team
